dms_database.title: Database
dms_database.description: Inspect schemas and tables, browse and fix rows, map relations and run queries.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Connection health, schemas and recent activity of the database.

beta.title: Beta
beta.body: Saved edits in the data browser are written straight to the database. Structure editing (columns, indexes, relations) comes with the Module Builder.
beta.meta_description: The one-line notice about writes and what is coming.

recent.title: Recent queries
recent.empty_description: Queries you run in the query console show up here.

connection.meta_description: Whether the database answers, its probe latency and what it holds.
connection.label: Connection

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Registered by modules. Open one to see its tables.
schemas.empty_description: Schemas appear here when a module declares tables with {'@'}RegisterTable. The connection itself is healthy.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Every table registered by your modules, its rows counted across all instances. Open one to inspect its columns, indexes and relations.

inspector.title: Table
inspector.meta_description: Columns, indexes, relations and a sample row of one table.

schemas.caption: Tables
schemas.table_meta_description: Every registered table, by schema, with its inspector.
schemas.footer_hint: J / K step through tables in the inspector

empty.first_description: Tables appear here when a module declares them with {'@'}RegisterTable.
empty.filtered_description: Search also looks inside column names. Try another schema or clear the search.

filters.meta_description: Narrows the tables by schema, instance, name and structure.
filters.label: Filter the tables

has_hint.modifiers: Tables with hashed, localized or encrypted columns
has_hint.empty: Tables with no row in the picked instance

data.title: Data browser
data.description: Browse and fix rows. Edits are staged and written only when you save them.
data.meta_description: Tables, rows and staged edits of one schema instance.

scope.open_hint: Click to preview, double-click to keep the tab

tabs.keep_hint: Preview tab: the next table you open replaces it. Keep it open.
tabs.close_description: Its staged change will be lost. | Its {count} staged changes will be lost.

grid.read_only_detail: You're reading {table} across every instance. Pick one instance to edit.
grid.invalid_number: Expected a number, e.g. 860.50 · Esc to cancel
grid.invalid_boolean: Expected true or false · Esc to cancel
grid.invalid_date: Expected a date, e.g. 2026-10-09 or 2026-10-09T14:30Z · Esc to cancel
grid.null_hint: Type null to empty the cell, \null for the text null

empty.pick_description: Choose a table on the left, or start from one you opened lately.
empty.pick_description_first: Choose a table on the left to see its rows.
empty.error_description: Your filters and unsaved changes are kept.
empty.no_match_description: Searched {count} rows in {table}. The row may live in another instance.
empty.no_rows_description: Rows written by your modules show up here.

save.review: Review and save {count} change | Review and save {count} changes
save.title: Save {count} change to {table}? | Save {count} changes to {table}?
save.description: It is written to {scope}. | They are written to {scope}.
save.saved: {count} change saved to {scope} | {count} changes saved to {scope}
save.partial_title: {saved} of {total} change saved | {saved} of {total} changes saved
save.rows_gone: {count} row no longer exists: its changes were dropped. | {count} rows no longer exist: their changes were dropped.
save.not_written: {count} change wasn't written and stays staged ({error}). | {count} changes weren't written and stay staged ({error}).
save.undo_partial: {count} change couldn't be undone | {count} changes couldn't be undone
save.rows_missing: {count} row no longer exists. | {count} rows no longer exist.

row.title: Row of {table}
row.references_failed: Couldn't count the rows pointing here.
row.references_none: No row of another table points to this one.

json.title: Edit {column}
json.not_structured: The value must be a JSON object, an array or null.

diagram.title: Diagram
diagram.description: Tables and relations of a schema. Drag tables to arrange them; the layout is saved for the whole team.

toolbar.auto_layout_hint: Rearrange every table; you preview it before keeping it

diagram.meta_description: The tables of a schema and their relations, with notes.
diagram.large: {count} tables: select one and focus on it to read its relations.

empty.title: No tables in {schema}
empty.description: This schema is registered but declares no table yet.

query.title: Query console
query.description: Write and run AQL against any schema. Queries that change data always show what they will touch first.
query.meta_description: The editor, its results and the library of past and saved queries.

library.history_empty: Queries you run show up here.
library.saved_empty: Queries you save show up here.
library.team_empty: Queries your teammates share show up here.

result.title: Result
result.copied: {count} row copied as JSON | {count} rows copied as JSON
result.first_title: Run a query to see results
result.first_description: Start from an example built on your own tables:
result.done: Done. The query answered no row.
result.all_shown: {count} row shown. | All {count} rows shown. Results over 1,000 rows are cut; add .slice() to page through them.
result.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} rows: results are cut at 1,000. Add .slice() to page through them.
result.table_first: The table shows the first {shown} of {total} rows; JSON and the CSV export hold them all.
result.failed_local: The query was not sent · nothing was changed

guard.description: This query changes data. A dry run found what it will touch:
guard.title_insert: Insert {count} row into {table}? | Insert {count} rows into {table}?
guard.title_update: Update {count} row in {table}? | Update {count} rows in {table}?
guard.title_replace: Replace {count} row in {table}? | Replace {count} rows in {table}?
guard.title_delete: Delete {count} row from {table}? | Delete {count} rows from {table}?
guard.skip: Don't ask again for single-row updates
guard.skip_detail: Until you close this browser tab. Deletes and changes to more than one row always ask.

save.title: Save query
save.description: Saved queries appear under Saved, and under Team when shared.
save.name: Name
save.share_description: Teammates can run it; only you can edit or delete it.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.shared: Teammates lose it from their Team tab too.

clear.title: Clear your query history?
clear.description: Your past runs are removed. Saved queries stay.

errors.syntax_string: Syntax error: the string opened at line {line}, column {column} is never closed.
